name: WANTED: Andre Firebeard
summary: A wanted notice in Gadgetzan and Steamwheedle Port names the pirate Andre Firebeard, who stands accused of crimes against Steamwheedle and Gadgetzan. The notice declares that his head, delivered to Security Chief Bilgewhizzle at Steamwheedle Port, counts as a binding contract.

sections.title: The Decree
sections.body: The notice calls Andre Firebeard a vile pirate, accused of crimes against Steamwheedle and Gadgetzan. The governing counsel has decreed that anyone who reads it may use lethal force in capturing Andre and those who aid him. He is to be found at the pirate enclave a way south along the coast from Steamwheedle Port, where he stands by a campfire inside the walls.

sections.title: The Head as Proxy
sections.body: A further decree says that if Andre is dead or otherwise unable to attend when his hearing comes, his head can act in his place. Delivered to Security Chief Bilgewhizzle at Steamwheedle Port, it counts as a binding contract.

sections.title: Terms of Payment
sections.body: Bilgewhizzle is pleased that Andre will make his trial after all. Payment is issued once you sign, and Bilgewhizzle waves off the small print as harmless, adding that it is too small for any magnifying glass to read.

faq.answer: A pirate accused of crimes against Steamwheedle and Gadgetzan.

faq.q: Where can the wanted notice be found?
faq.answer: In Gadgetzan and at Steamwheedle Port.
At a campfire inside the walls of the pirate enclave, a way south along the coast from Steamwheedle Port.

faq.q: Who receives the head once Andre is dealt with?
aliases: who do i turn in firebeard to
where to turn in firebeard head
faq.answer: Security Chief Bilgewhizzle, in Steamwheedle Port.
A decree lets it act in his place if he is dead or otherwise unable to attend when his hearing comes.
